# Boundary goldens for autojunk (deterministic search, seed 7).
import difflib, json, random
rnd = random.Random(7)
ASCII = [chr(c) for c in range(33, 127)] + [" "] + [chr(c) for c in range(0xC0, 0x100)]
CJK = [chr(0x4E00 + i) for i in range(300)]
def junked_x(a, b, x):
    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b, autojunk=False)
    sm.b2j.pop(x, None)
    return sm.ratio()
def make(n, count, pool, x):
    others = [c for c in pool if c != x]
    ntest = n // 100 + 1
    cap = ntest  # others never popular
    body = []
    while len(body) < n - count:
        c = rnd.choice(others)
        if body.count(c) < cap:
            body.append(c)
    b = body + [x] * count
    rnd.shuffle(b)
    return b
def find(n, count, pool, must_differ):
    x = pool[0]
    for _ in range(4000):
        b = make(n, count, pool, x)
        # a: b with edits so x runs matter
        a = list(b)
        for _ in range(rnd.randrange(1, 6)):   # move blocks around so seeds matter
            i = rnd.randrange(len(a)); j = rnd.randrange(i, min(len(a), i + 40)) + 1
            blk = a[i:j]; del a[i:j]
            at = rnd.randrange(len(a) + 1); a[at:at] = blk
        a, bs = "".join(a), "".join(b)
        r1 = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, bs, autojunk=False).ratio()
        r2 = junked_x(a, bs, x)
        if (r1 != r2) == must_differ:
            return a, bs
    raise SystemExit("no case %r" % ((n, count, must_differ),))
cases = []
for n, count, pool in [(199, 2, ASCII), (199, 3, ASCII), (200, 3, ASCII), (200, 4, ASCII),
                       (150, 3, CJK), (200, 3, CJK), (200, 4, CJK), (250, 4, CJK), (250, 3, CJK)]:
    a, b = find(n, count, pool, True)
    assert len(b) == n and b.count(pool[0]) == count
    cases.append([a, b, repr(difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b).ratio())])
print(json.dumps(cases, ensure_ascii=False))
